method: Call-graph + linker-layout carving, no string-content matching. Loaded functions.csv/call_graph.csv (29,405 edges) in Python, then added three structural parses of original/game/cataclysm.exe: RTTI CompleteObjectLocators->vftables (311; namespace of each slot), EH ThrowInfo/CatchableType (37 thrown types; throw sites, copy-ctors, dtors), and the 908 MSVC6 __ehhandler stubs (mov eax,FuncInfo; jmp __CxxFrameHandler 0x678d60) whose FuncInfo unwind/try maps tie 2,336 of 2,343 text$x Unwind@ funclets and 105 Catch@ funclets to their parent (parent = function containing push <stub>); each funclet inherits its parent's class. Import-thunk runs (jmp [IAT]) mark lib boundaries. Inferred .text layout: 0x401000-0x5ca0ff game objs (HW1/Cataclysm C, game C++ Titan glue ~0x552000-0x5a4900 carrying shared std/WON COMDATs); 0x5ca100-0x5d6fdf IJG libjpeg (closed cluster: entered only from game glue 0x5c9cd0/0x5c9dc0/0x5c9f80, exits only to CRT; TUs alphabetical jcapimin..jcomapi..jdapimin..jerror..jmemmgr/jmemnobs..jutils); 0x5d6fe0-0x670a0f kas2c mission code (no Ghidra functions); 0x670a10-0x670a45 WSOCK32 thunks; 0x670a50-0x69411d MSVC6 static debug CRT (LIBCMTD; tail 0x693dc7-0x694111 = libcp _Xlen/_Xran helpers); 0x69411e-0x69412b RtlUnwind/ChooseFontA thunks; 0x694130-0x6e3adf WON titan SDK (msg/auth/crypt incl. CryptoPP, common, misc sockets, AdApi); 0x6e3de0-0x6e4b9f Magick++; 0x6e4ba0-0x6eaaaf ImageMagick C; 0x6eaab0-0x6ead6f Magick++ (Geometry); 0x6ead70-0x6f13df WON AdApi; 0x6f13e0-0x6f537f Magick++ (LastError, Exception classes, Thread mutex); 0x6f5380-0x705c8f ImageMagick C + coders; 0x705c90 DDRAW thunks; 0x705ca0-0x71cc67 MSVC C++ std lib (iostream/locale/strstream); 0x71cc68-0x71cccf WSOCK32 thunks; 0x71ccd0-0x71f62f late-pulled CRT (threadex, asctime, RTTI dynamic_cast, wide stdio); 0x71f630-0x729a5f text$x EH funclets + stubs. .cms_t: 0xc55000-0xc6068f protection stub (SecuROM by section name, inference), 0xc60690-0xc67ca5 its own static release CRT; the 42 one-byte .data 'functions' are disassembly artefacts of .cms_t and are not proposed. WinMain = 0x005631f0 (CET_container name InitWindow): sole caller is the CRT entry 0x0067bbe0, called as WinMain(GetModuleHandleA(0),0,_wincmdln(),nShow) with the result passed to exit(); its body is HW1 SDL/main.c main() (LSMap mapping, utyGameSystemsInit, message loop) with InitWindow inlined. The CRT entry closure without WinMain is 148 functions, all in 0x670a50-0x69411d; crt0.c call order named _heap_init/_mtinit/_ioinit/__crtGetEnvironmentStringsA/_setargv/_setenvp/_cinit/_wincmdln/exit. The PE exports (SetClientName, opendir, NTElapsedTime, ...) are ImageMagick nt.c/client MagickExport symbols, not WON; seekdir 0x49ae30 and telldir 0x6fe9a0 are ICF-folded stubs and are left out. Class rules: WON vs ImageMagick split by direction (WON calls ImageMagick, never the reverse): WON seeds = WSOCK32 callers + WON/CryptoPP RTTI vftable slots + WON throw types, propagated to callers; ImageMagick seeds = nt.c exports + Magick:: throw types, C-call component of the exports; zero conflicts. Functions physically inside WON/Magick objs or game C++ objs but called by C++ std lib/CRT code (or by both WON and ImageMagick) are std template COMDATs -> class crt (lib-strings calls ~60 of these won). Confidence: high = linker block + independent graph/RTTI/EH signal (+ named-lib or startup-closure); medium = linker block + graph-consistent callees only; low = conflicting or boundary-uncertain. Class enum has no jpeg/ImageMagick/protection value, so those use class unknown with evidence prefixed 'lib:'. Names are given only where call order/structure pins them (CRT startup, IJG jcomapi/jerror/create fns, WinMain, WinMainCRTStartup); other entries carry name "" (class only, existing FID/CET names untouched).
